name: R042-cradily-ancientpower-psych-up
why: The player's Claydol (set 524, Levitate, Leftovers) raises Defense and Sp. Def with Cosmic Power, then evasion with Double Team, so the target has a stat at +3 or more. The opponent's Cradily (set 512: Earthquake, AncientPower, Swagger, Psych Up) cannot touch Claydol with Earthquake and AncientPower is resisted, so the battle is long. When AncientPower's 10% all-stats boost lands, the next turn AI_CV_PsychUp finds the user's Attack, Defense and Sp. Atk raised and tests Sp. Def and evasion (and, if Cradily copied Claydol's evasion with Psych Up before, the final roll).
